messages.speaker: Melanie
messages.content: Hi Anna! I'm Melanie. I work as a nurse at Harborview Medical Center, and I've been there since 2020.

messages.speaker: Anna
messages.content: Nice to meet you, Melanie! I'm Anna. I enjoy hiking on weekends, and I have mild asthma.

messages.speaker: Melanie
messages.content: I moved to Seattle last month. It's great that we met at the Harborview charity gala in June.
